input.text: A heavy fist hitting a wooden plank: a dull, weighty thump with a sharp knock of dry wood. Close and punchy. No voices, no music.
Old dry wood cracking and splintering under a heavy blow: sharp crackles and the snap of wood fibers tearing. Short. No voices, no music.
A hard bare-knuckle punch slamming into an old thin wooden door: a deep hollow wooden thud and a short rattle of the loose door in its frame. Close, dry and punchy. No voices, no music.
A powerful punch smashing into old wooden planks: a big low thud with creaking wood and a short buzz of a rattling door. Close, cinematic. No voices, no music.
Knuckles striking hard wood: a short fleshy smack with a dry knock. Very close. No voices, no music.
A rotten wooden plank snaps in half and breaks off a door with a splintering crack, then the broken piece clatters onto a concrete floor. No voices, no music.

An old wooden door is violently smashed apart by one massive blow: a huge explosive crack of splintering wood, planks bursting apart, rusty hinges tearing off, then heavy wooden debris crashing and scattering across the concrete floor of a small bunker room. Powerful, cinematic, very satisfying. No voices, no music.
Small wooden splinters and chips falling and bouncing on a concrete floor, then settling. No voices, no music.
A fast punch swinging through the air: one short, sharp whoosh close to the microphone. No voices, no music.
A quick arm swing whoosh, a punch cutting the air, short and crisp. No voices, no music.
Loose rusty metal hinges and an old wooden door rattling and creaking in its frame right after being hit. No voices, no music.
A caged incandescent light bulb flickering for a moment with an electrical buzz and crackle. No voices, no music.
A wooden board splitting with a loud crack, splinters snapping. Short and sharp. No voices, no music.

Ambience of a small underground concrete bunker room: a low steady ventilation hum, a faint electrical buzz from a caged light bulb, an occasional distant water drip. Calm and continuous. No voices, no music.
